sanskrit: praṇamya śirasā devī gaurī pṛcchati śaṅkaramprasādaṃ kuru deveśa brūhi dharmārthasādhakamśāntikaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ vātha karaṇāni bahūni cajñānahāniṃ kriyāhāniṃ kīlakaṃ ca tathāparammantradhyānaṃ viśeṣeṇa tatsarvaṃ vada me prabhoyasya vijñānamātreṇa manuṣyo bhuvi durlabhaḥtadvadiṣyāmi te devi tatsarvaṃ samudāhṛtamuḍḍīśāt sāramākṛṣya mayoktaṃ tava bhaktitaḥkapardinaṃ virūpākṣaṃ sarvabhūtabhayāpahamtaistu prayojitaiḥ sadyaḥ prāṇān hanti na saṃśayaḥtṛtīyaṃ dveṣaṇaṃ cātha turyamuccāṭanaṃ tathāvahneḥ stambhakaraṃ cātha vaśīkaraṇamuttamamśivena kathitā yogā uḍḍīśe śāstraniścayebhūtajvarasya karaṇamastraśastrasya dūṣaṇamvināśaṃ mattakaraṇaṃ gajavājiprakopanamvahnervināśanaṃ kuryāt parṇānāṃ hi vināśanamvetālapādukāsiddhimulvakājjvalanaṃ tathāvidyāmantraprayogādīn auṣadhāṃścābhicārikānuḍḍīśaṃ yo na jānāti sa ruṣṭaḥ kiṃ kariṣyatisūryaṃ ca pātayedbhūmau nedaṃ mithyā bhaviṣyatiyamasya ca yathā daṇḍaṃ kuberasya gadā yathāśūlapāṇinaḥtathaite ca mahāyogāḥ prayuktāḥ śatrukāraṇesantuṣṭena prayuktena sidhyanti suvicārataḥyenaiva kṛtamātreṇa bhūto gṛhṇāti mānavam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00169 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śatruviṣṭhāsamāliptaṃ tathā nāma samālikhetcitāntaḥ saṃsthito bhūtvā yasya gātramṛdāharetbhūto gṛhṇāti taṃ śīghraṃ mantreṇānena mantritaḥdāpayed devamīśānaṃ ghṛtena vacayā sahamantreṇa mantrayitvā tu tataḥ svāsthyaṃ bhavet kilayenaiva kṛtamātreṇa jvaro gṛhṇāti mānavamtasyā hṛdi viṣonmattarājikālavaṇaistathātatastu śatrunāmnā ca aṣṭottaraśataṃ japetpratyānayaṃ yadīccheta tasyaiṣā kriyate kriyāathānyat saṃpravakṣyāmi prayogaṃ bhuvi durlabhambrahmadaṇḍī citābhasma gomayasya tathaiva cakṣipecchirasi śatrūṇāṃ tūrṇamuccāṭayedripummuṇḍanaṃ cātha keśānāṃ tataḥ svastho bhaved dhruvamdhūpaṃ nirbhedakaṃ nāma svayaṃ rudreṇa bhāṣitamnirmokaṃ sarparājasya dhūpamuccāṭayedripūnnikhanedyasya ca dvāre tamuccāṭayate haṭhātśmaśānabhasmasaṃyuktaṃ kapāle mānuṣe nyasetsaptarātreṇa deveśi samūlaṃ naśyate gṛhamyenaiva kṛtamātreṇa vidveṣo jāyate nṛṇāmjātīpuṣparasairbhāvyā saptarātraṃ punaḥ punaḥeṣa dhūpaḥ pradātavyaḥ śatrugotrasya madhyataḥvidveṣaṇaṃ paraṃ teṣāṃ suhṛdbhirbāndhavaiḥ sahasurāṃ mānuṣamāṃsaṃ ca samādāya vicakṣaṇaḥsaptāhena bhavenmāro yathā rudreṇa bhāṣitamariṣṭasya ca patrāṇi viṣaṃ rudhirameva ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00169 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: saptarātraprayogena sarvaśatrupraṇāśanamśatamaṣṭottareṇaiva mantrayitvā vicakṣaṇaḥdevamabhyarcya ceśānaṃ śatamaṣṭādhikaṃ japetśatrusainye prayoktavyaṃ rājñaśca vijayārthinaḥindragopakasaṃyuktaṃ jambūkasya śirastathāamukte hi prayoktavyaṃ sarvaṃ janaśataṃ haretvṛścikasya tu lāṅgūlaṃ hālāhalakameva cagṛhītvā samabhāgāni sūkṣmacūrṇāni kārayetanne pāne pradātavyaṃ ripusainyavināśanamtasya dehe jvarastīvro bhavet tīvrā ca vedanāathānyat saṃpravakṣyāmi yasya dhyānena sādhanamrudhiraṃ kṛṣṇasarpasya kukkuṭasya tu kasyacitkuṅkumaṃ bhadramustaṃ ca tagaraṃ kṛṣṇameva caaśleṣāyāṃ tu piṣṭāni kṛtvā pātre ca rājateasidhārāṅgadā nāma svayaṃ rudreṇa bhāṣitāphalapuṣpe tathā patre dhūpasattaistathaiva caanne pāne mantrayitvā prayuñjīta vidhānataḥaṣṭottarasahasraṃ tu tato mantramimaṃ japettadaśaktau citāyāṃ tu yathāśakti punaḥ punaḥsarve caiva prayoktavyāḥ sarvaśatruvināśakāḥabhaktve naiva proktavyaṃ krūre pāpajane tathāuḍḍāmareśvaramahātantre prathamaḥ paṭalaḥkumbhīravelvadaṃṣṭrāni rudhiraṃ māṃsameva cavibhītakasya tailena sarvānekatra kārayetmadrakasya rasaṃ grāhyaṃ lakṣaṇasya makarasya ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00169 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vibhītakasya taila tu pacyamāne ca dāpayettattailaṃ pācayet lauhe kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ samāhitaḥabhimantrya ca mantreṇa mṛttikāsnānadakṣiṇamanena mantrayitvā tu tataḥ sidhyati nānyathābhallātakarasaṃ guñjā viṣaṃ citrakameva caetatsarvasamāyukto lūtākaraṇamuttamamaṅgāni dhūmamāyānti mūrcchayanti muhurmuhuḥcikitsāṃ tasya vakṣyāmi yena saṃpadyate sukhamraktacandanakuṣṭhaṃ ca lepo lūtāvināśanaḥkṛṣṇasarpaśiro grāhyaṃ mukhe niḥkṣipya sarṣapānvalmīkasya mṛdaḥkośe antardhūmena pācayetviṣasya cūrṇaṃ kṛtvā tu śatrūṇāṃ mūrdhni niḥkṣipetprasvinne ca tato gātre lagnāstasmiṃstu sarṣapāḥvedanājātamātreṇa mantrajāpaṃ tu pūrvavatatha śasyavināśaṃ ca kathayāmi samāsataḥkṣetre saṃpātayed yasmiṃstasmiñśasyavināśanamatha mantraṃ punarvakṣye prayogeṣu prayojakamparṇānāṃ caiva yogena kṣipet parṇaṃ vinaśyatiyenaiva kṛtamātreṇa grāmasyoccāṭanaṃ bhavetgomayenākṛtiṃ kṛtvā grāmasya ca caturdiśaḥhutvā cāhutisāhasraṃ tato bhasma samāharetśatavārābhijaptena anenaiva tu mantritaḥucchedanaṃ bhavatyeva ripūṇāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥkulvīkāraṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu yogaṃ samāsataḥpādapāṃśusamāyuktairantarā ghṛtagomayaiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00169 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ekaviṃśativāraṃ hi mantreṇānena mantritāmprasthitānāṃ ca karaṇe mantreṇānena mantravitsnātvā ca gavyadugdhena tataḥ svastho bhaviṣyatigṛhacaṭakasya viṣṭhā ca tathā karañjabījakamekaviṃśativāraṃ ca mantreṇānena mantritamajākṣīreṇa śoṇitena pibettu śatapuṣpikāmekaviṃśativāraṃ hi mantritaṃ lavaṇaṃ kharamlavaṇaṃ tantu saṃgṛhya cūrṇaṃ kṛtvā vicakṣaṇaḥmantritaṃ śatavāraṃ ca śatrorvā yasya kasyacitathānyat saṃpravakṣyāmi kuṣṭhīkaraṇamuttamambhallātakarasaṃ guñjā tathā maṇḍalakārikāsaptāhājjāyate kuṣṭhaṃ tatpītaṃ ca samedhitamdhātrīkhadiranimbāni śarkarāsahitāni caśālibhaktaṃ paṭolaṃ ca ghṛtayuktaṃ tu pāyasametena dattamātreṇa naraḥ saṃpadyate sukhamtasya saṃdāpayeddhīmān yasya icchettu jīvitamyadīcchejjīvitaṃ tasya aṅgaṃ prakṣālayed dhruvamtailenodvartayelliṅgaṃ kṣālayet śītavāriṇāathānyat saṃpravakṣyāmi vaśyādikaraṇaṃ parampurāṇikasya hṛdayaṃ tathā kuṣṭhena bhāvitamniyataṃ kiṅkaro bhūtvā yāvajjīvaṃ sa tiṣṭhaticandanaṃ tagaraṃ kuṣṭhaṃ priyaṅgunāgakesaramchāyāyāṃ vaṭikā kāryā pradeyā khānapānataḥsaptāhaṃ mantritaṃ kṛtvā mantreṇānena mantravitśvetā ca girikarṇī ca samaṃ saptāhabhāvitāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00169 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: taṃ vaśīkaraṇaṃ proktaṃ yāvajjīvaṃ na saṃśayaḥdivyaṃ vacā viśālākṣā kambugrīvā suśobhanādadāti daśamīnā ca mantraḥ kaścit pragṛhyatejalamadhye sahā cauraṃ kurute vartiko mamatatkṣaṇaṃ syātgaruḍoktaṃ viṣaharamauṣadhaṃ prāṇijīvanambiḍālasya varāhasya kākabhekasya ca tvacaḥanenāñjitanetro hi rātrau paśyedyathā divāekarātroṣito bhūtvā kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ samāhitaḥdakṣiṇasyāṃ diśi sthitvā śatamaṣṭottaraṃ japetkanakasya ca bījāni priyaṅgu guggulastathāyogamimaṃ samāghrāti sa vaśyo jāyate bhṛśamkuṣṭhaṃ ca devadāruṃ ca sarvamekīkṛtaṃ tathāyatra yatra praviṣṭastu tatra tatra jayī bhavetuḍḍāmareśvaramahātantre dvitīyaḥ paṭalaḥśmaśānabhasmasaṃyuktaṃ śatroruccāṭanaṃ bhavetyenaiva jñātamātreṇa śatravo yānti vaśyatāmbhāvayet saptarātraṃ tu bhojanaiḥ saha dāpayetsvasthīkāre pradātavyā jayā tu madhuyaṣṭikābhāvayet saptarātraṃ tu bhojanaiḥ saha dīyateśarkarādugdhapānena svastho bhavati nānyathāmarditvā yātayāmābhyāṃ gṛhyate brahmarākṣasaiḥkapikacchukaniryāsairmātuluṅgasya bījakamāmalakyāśca cūrṇena strīdugdhasahitena caśarkarāpadmakiñjalkapadmakesarakalkakaiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00169 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tadā duṣṭagrahairmuktaḥ svasthaśca jāyate naraḥuḍḍāmareśvaramahātantre tṛtīyaḥ paṭalaḥyena vijñānamātreṇa sarvasiddhiḥ prajāyateuḍḍāmareśvaramahātantre caturthaḥ paṭalaḥparapuruṣā vaśaṃ yānti yathāvat kathayāmi teśmaśānabhasmasaṃyuktaṃ prayogaṃ māraṇāntakametāni samabhāgāni sthāpayet tāmrabhājanetailena bhagamālipya bhartāramupagacchatināgaraiḥ madhusaṃyuktairguṭikāṃ kārayedbudhaḥkuṅkumaṃ śatapuṣpaṃ ca priyaṅgu rocanaṃ tataḥtataḥ sā subhagā nityaṃ patidāsatvamāpnuyātsamudrajaṃ raktacūrṇaṃ madhunā saha lepayetadhunā saṃpravakṣyāmi yogānāṃ sāramuttamamuśīraṃ candanaṃ caiva madhunā saha saṃyutamkevalaṃ śaśinā yuktaṃ kuṅkumaṃ lepayed bhagelavaṅgaṃ saindhavaṃ kṣaudraṃ pippalī maricāni cavaraṭāveśmasambānaṃ (?) śītatoyena peṣayettatra prakṣālitenātha prasavatvaṃ bhaviṣyativāmapādaṃ striyo limpet sā tasya vaśagā bhavetyāvadāyurbhaved dāsaḥ sa tasyā nātra saṃśayaḥliptvā liṅgaṃ bhajedyāṃ tu sā vaśyā syādvarāṅganāpiṣṭvā liptvā rajo yāṃ ca bhajetsā vaśyagā bhavetebhirviliptaliṅgo yāṃ bhajate sā vaśā bhavetuḍḍāmareśvaramahātantre pañcamaḥ paṭalaḥnivedanīyaḥ kasyāpi na kadāciditi bruve
source_edition: Muktabodha M00169 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yena vijñānamātreṇa jāyate ca śubhāśubhamsukhaduḥkhaṃ bhavābhāvau gamanāgamanaṃ tathāuḍḍāmareśvaramahātantre ṣaṣṭhaḥ paṭalaḥyasyāḥ prayogamātreṇa devatā yānti vaśyatāmsurāsuragaṇaiḥ pūjyā sarvakāryārthasādhinīanena vidhinā devi catuścaraṇagāminīśucirārabhya ekānte prabhāte mantramuktitaḥnamo'stvamṛtasaṃbhūte balavīryavivardhiniatraiva tiṣṭha kalyāṇi mama kāryakarī bhavaabhimantrya tu mantreṇa sāpi putravatī bhavetādivandhyāpi deveśi bhavedgarbhavatī hi sātasyāṃ nadyāṃ diśi snātvā vandhyā putravatī bhavetsnātvā vidhiprakāreṇa maṇḍalaṃ kārayet tataḥtanmadhye vilikhet paścādaṣṭapatraṃ sakarṇikamnirvraṇamaṇḍalasyāgre kamalaṃ sthāpayed budhaḥanenaiva vidhānena kanyā prāpnoti satpatimnavābhicāritāḥ kūrāḥ śuddhadehā bhavanti tete sarve pralayaṃ yānti satyaṃ devi mayoditambrahmahatyādayo doṣāḥ kṣayaṃ yānti na saṃśayaḥye sidhyanti daśānyūnaṃ mantrasādhanamuktidāḥuḍḍāmareśvaramahātantre mayūraśikhānirūpaṇamaṣṭamaḥ paṭalaḥāsphoṭī nāma vikhyātā nāgadamanīti viśrutāviṣāḥ sarve vinaśyanti lepanādbhakṣaṇāt kṣaṇātkāmināṃ prītijanakaṃ kiñcittadapi gadyateetān piṣṭvā svavīryeṇa yaḥ kuryāt tilakaṃ pumān
source_edition: Muktabodha M00169 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vātsyāyanena muninā proktaṃ yogamanuttamamstrīyoniśoṇite caitadekīkṛtya lalāṭakekṛtajñaḥ svavaśaṃ kuryānmodate ca ciraṃ bhuvietatsamaṃ svapañcāṅgamale nītvaikatāṃ sudhīḥjagatsarvaṃ vaśīkuryāt sa pumānnātra saṃśayaḥkuryāt sā tilakaṃ bhāle patiṃ ca mohayedbhṛśampātitaṃ kajjalaṃ viśvaṃ mohayennayanāñjanātyojayed dṛṣṭipathagaṃ sarvameva vimohayetsiddhārthataile niḥkṣipya kajjalaṃ naramastakedṛṣṭigocaramāyātaḥ sarvo bhavati dāsavatpuṣyarkṣayoge vihitaṃ daṃpatyormohanaṃ paramcūrṇaṃ tagarajaṃ caiṣāṃ cūrṇaṃ kṣiptaṃ vimohanepakṣāvaleridaṃ cūrṇaṃ kṣiptaṃ śirasi mohanampūrayitvā svavīryeṇa sārameyagale kṣipetpaścānniṣkāsya saṃśodhya vaṭīṃ kuryādviśoṣayetdaṃpatyoḥ prītijananī kīrtitā niyamottamākumbhakena varārohe śṛṇu vakṣyāmi ṣaḍguṇammāsenaikena manunā ānayennāgakanyakāmanenaiva tu mantreṇa dhyātavyāḥ krodhayājakāḥmāsena mānuṣaṃ lokaṃ nāgalokaṃ dvimāsataḥṣaṇmāsābhyāsayogena trailokyaṃ niścalaṃ kuruṛkṣaturagagato vāyurjīmūta iva garjitaḥtena sthāpitamātreṇa traimāsikajvaraṃ haretpadmasūtrotthavartiṃ ca bhāvayet saptavārakamtenāñjitalocanastu adṛśyo bhavati dhruvam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00169 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: suvarṇaśataṃ tasmai sādhakāya pratyahaṃ dadātisādhakāya prayacchatiparantvanyāḥ striyo varjanīyāḥdadātipratyahaṃ sādhakāya prayacchativastraṃ rasāyanamaṣṭadināntareṇa dadātisahasraṃ dadāti | tasyāḥ prasādena varṣasahasrāṇyāyuśca bhavativiśālā madanā ghaṇṭā kālakarṇī mahābhayāmekhalā vikalā lakṣmīrmālinī śatapatrikānaṭī kāmeśvarī svarṇarekhā ca surasundarībhāminī padminī caiva svarṇavatī ratipriyākaraṅkiṇīmate tantre mahādevena vistarātphalaṃ caiva yathā tuṣṭāḥ prayacchanti samāhitampaścāccampakapuṣpaiśca homaṃ madhughṛtānvitamtataḥ siddhā bhaved devi vicitrā vāñchitapradāghṛtāktairguggulairhome daśāṃśena kṛte satidadāti bhojanaṃ dravyaṃ pratyahaṃ śaṅkaro'bravītpadmapatrairghṛtopetaiḥ kṛte home daśāṃśataḥsukhena taṃ ca gṛhṇāti na vighnaiḥ paribhūyateghṛtāktaguggulairhome bhīṣaṇī cintitapradāghṛtāktaguggulairhome devī saubhāgyadā bhavetśatapatrodbhavaiḥ puṣpaiḥ saghṛtairhomamācaretdadāti mantriṇe tuṣṭā rasaṃ divyarasāyanamsakṣīramālatīpuṣpaiḥ kṛte home daśāṃśataḥyayā āsyasthayādṛśyaḥ śuciḥ sthāyī bhavennaraḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00169 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tatra kṣobhayate lokān darśanādeva sādhakaḥmadhunāktaiḥ kṛte home kālakarṇī prasīdatisatataṃ saṃsmarenmantrī vividhāścaryakāriṇīmtato mahābhayā siddhā yacchatyasya rasāyanamvallīpalitanirmukto na rogaṃ samavāpnuyātjapenmantraṃ tataḥ siddhā bhavet pātālasiddhidāśaṅkhamālikayā paścādindhanaiḥ karavīrajaiḥdhruvaṃ siddhā bhaved devī śaṅkhinī vāñchitapradānagnavrato'ñjanaṃ tuṣṭā śmaśāne saṃprayacchatinidhiṃ paśyati gṛhṇāti na vighneḥ paribhūyatelakṣatrayaṃ tataḥ siddhā devī syādvaṭayakṣiṇīdivyāñjanaṃ ca saṃtuṣṭā sādhakasya prayacchatiprajapenmekhalā tuṣṭā dadātyañjanamuttamamtataḥ siddhā bhaveddevi vikalā vāñchitapradālakṣamāvartayenmantrī dūrvājyābhyāṃ daśāṃśataḥrasaṃ rasāyanaṃ divyaṃ nidhānaṃ ca prayacchatimālinī jāyate siddhā divyaṃ khaḍgaṃ prayacchatikṣīrājyahomaiḥ saṃsiddhā siddhiṃ yacchati bhūnidhimghṛtahome daśāṃśena kṛte devī prasīdatimanaḥpavanavegena yāti cāyāti sādhakaḥjapet siddhā bhaved devī śobhanā bhogadāyinīlakṣadvayaṃ japenmantraṃ kapālaṃ labhate muniḥdūrāddarśanamityādi sādhakāya prayacchatighṛtāktaguggulairhome devī saubhāgyadā bhavetkṛtvā cābhyarcayed devīṃ dhūpaṃ dattvā sahasrakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00169 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: rātrau pūjāṃ śubhāṃ kṛtvā japenmantraṃ munivrataḥdadāti mantriṇe mantraṃ divyayogaṃ ca siddhidammāsamekaṃ japenmantraṃ tadā pūjāṃ samārabhetrātrau devīṃ samabhyarcya japenmantraṃ prasannadhīḥrasaṃ rasāyanaṃ divyaṃ vastrālaṅkaraṇāni cavidhāya pūjayed devīṃ tato mantrāyutaṃ japetardharātre gate devī dīnārāṇāṃ sahasrakamtadvyayābhāvato bhūyo na dadāti prakupyatimāsamekaṃ tato devī nidhiṃ darśayati dhruvampratipattithimārabhya dhūpadīpādibhirvarāmmāsamekaṃ tataḥ pūjāṃ rātrau kṛtvā punarjapetdīnārāṇāṃ sahasraikaṃ pratyahaṃ paritoṣitā(32) gatvā pakṣigṛhaṃ mantrī nakhakeśaiḥ prapūjayetāvartayedekacitto mantrī mantraṃ susaṃyataḥ(33) dinatrayamanāhārī somasūryagrahe satitataḥ prasannā sā devī yacchatyañjanamuttamam(35) vaṭavṛkṣatale kṛtvā candanena sumaṇḍalamśaśamāṃsaṃ ghṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ mantramāvartayet tataḥathāgatya sadā tasmai mantramañjanamuttamam(36) śaṅkhaliptapaṭe yasmād devīṃ gaurīṃ dhṛtotpalāmjātīpuṣpaiḥ prapūjyātha sahasraṃ parivartayetardharātre gate devī samāgatya prayacchativāñchitaṃ manasastasmai mantrajñāya na saṃśayaḥuḍḍāmareśvaratantre yakṣiṇīpaṭalaḥ navamaḥjapto'vaśyaṃ vaśyakaro mantro'yaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00169 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mṛtakotthāpanaṃ kuryāt pratimāṃ cālayettathāpatrapuṣpaphalādīni karotyākarṣaṇaṃ dhruvampratyahaṃ maṇibhadrākhyaḥ prayacchatyekarūpyakamsahasraṃ hi japennityaṃ yāvat svapnaṃ prajāyatelakṣajāpe kṛte siddho datte sāgaraceṭakaḥsahasradaśakaṃ nityaṃ rātrau mantraṃ japet sudhīḥuḍḍāmareśvaramahātantre yakṣiṇīceṭakanirūpaṇaṃ daśamaḥ paṭalaḥtrirātraṃ pañcarātraṃ ca yonirbhavati saṃyutāebhirmāsaprayogaṃ ca bhagalepanamuttamamṛtukāle'thavā kuryāt tadā tattulyatā bhavetsatatamabhilepena sā bhartāraṃ vaśaṃ nayetlepanāttu tataḥ śiśnaṃ yathecchaṃ kāmayedbalātlepaṃ prakṣālitaṃ liṅgaṃ nārī kāmayate cirātnābhilepanamityuktaṃ vīryastambhakaraṃ parambhūrjapatre'thavā vastre netre baddhaphalādikesādhyanāma tathā madhye karṇikāyāṃ viśeṣataḥmṛttikābhiḥ samastābhiḥ pratimāṃ kārayed dṛḍhamvairāgyaṃ na punaryāti dāsībhāvena tiṣṭhaticūrṇaṃ bhūmandarā śākhā dantanakhaṃ karoti vainetrāñjanasamāyuktaṃ sarvasattvavaśaṅkarampraṇamya śirasā gaurī paripṛcchati śaṅkaramtaṃ vadiṣyāmi te devi sarvaṃ tatsamudāhṛtampūrvoditaṃ mayoḍḍīśaṃ kathyate tava bhaktitaḥkapardinaṃ virūpākṣaṃ sarvabhūtabhayāvahamtṛtīyaṃ dveṣaṇaṃ caiva turyamuccāṭanaṃ tathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00169 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: saptamamagnistambhaṃ ca vaśīkaraṇamaṣṭamamśivena kathitā yogā uḍḍīśe śāstraniścayegātrasaṃkocanaṃ caiva bhūtajvarakarastathādadhimadhunāśanaṃ ca mattakaraṇaṃ tathaiva caākarṣaṇaṃ bhujaṅgānāṃ mānavānāṃ tathā dhruvamvetālāñjanasiddhiśca ulūkasiddhirapi hividyāmantraprayogāṃśca auṣadhaṃ cābhicārikamakulīnādhamabuddherbhaktihīnasya vai tathāsvārthaṃ phalādilubdhasya upadeśamamanyataḥetaiśca sahasaṃyogo na kāryaḥ sarvadā budhaiḥte duṣṭā durjayāścaiva kimatra bahubhāṣitaiḥsatpūruṣāya dātavyaṃ devagururatāya caanimittā nivartante svātmagrāhe na saṃśayaḥśāstrasiddhavicārāstu sāmantakoṣakāḥ ? śubhāḥlambodaraṃ prakurvīta pūjayedupacārakaiḥsahasraikapramāṇena japācchāntirbhaviṣyatimāsenaikena deveśi śrīlābhaśca bhaved dhruvamtrikālajñānavettā ca varṣaikena na saṃśayaḥvaradāṃ tu mahādevīṃ śvetagandhānulepanaiḥsaptame divase hyevaṃ vāgaiśvaryaṃ prajāyatebāndhavaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ cirāyuḥ sukhamedhateraktavastrāvṛto nityaṃ tathā kuṅkumajāṅgalepūrvavidhānapūto hi japedekāntasaṃsthitaḥūrdhvadṛṣṭiprayogeṇa japellakṣatrayaṃ priyeekapādasthito bhadre japedaṣṭottaraṃ śatam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00169 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yajennaraviśeṣaṃ ca devāgnigurubrāhmaṇaiḥśarāvaṃ pūrayitvā tu catuṣpathe baliṃ haretātmacintitakāryāṇi sādhayatyeva nānyathāsaṃmukhībhūya kṣiptvā ca japtvā cāyutaṃ ? vāsaremadhyāhnasamaye sūryasaṃmukhe japamācarettasya dṛṣṭinipātena dvipadaśca catuṣpadaḥekaviṃśatijaptena jalena jvarapīḍitaḥtannāmakīrtanādeva hṛtaṃ naṣṭaṃ ca labhyateuḍḍāmareśvaramahātantre mantrakoṣanirūpaṇaṃ dvādaśaḥ paṭalaḥgṛhe'rcāṃ kārayeddevaṃ śivaṃ devyā sahārcayetatha snānaphalaṃ vakṣye yathoktaṃ tripurāriṇāśāntyarthī śāntimāpnoti durbhagā subhagā bhavetabhāryo labhate bhāryāṃ sukhārthī sukhamāpnuyātuḍḍāmareśvaramahātantre mantrakoṣanirūpaṇaṃ trayodaśaḥ paṭalaḥmantrakoṣakathanaṃ caturdaśaḥ paṭalaḥpañcadaśaḥ paṭalaḥ samāptamidam
